arxiv-2201-11591.title: Inversion of the chemical environment representations
arxiv-2201-11591.creator: Matteo Cobelli, Paddy Cahalane, Stefano Sanvito
arxiv-2201-11591.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Matteo Cobelli, Paddy Cahalane, Stefano Sanvito. Machine-learning generative methods for material design are constructed by representing a given chemical structure, either a solid or a molecule, over appropriate atomic features, generally called structural descriptors. These must be fully descriptive of the system, must facilitate the training process and must be invertible, so that one can extract the atomic configurations corresponding to the output of the model.

arxiv-2210-13483.title: Global CD/EoR Signal Detection with a Dense Digital Beamforming Array and Beyond 2022 Global CD/EoR Signal Detection with a Dense Digital Beamforming Array and Beyond – References
arxiv-2210-13483.creator: Junhua Gu, Jingying Wang, Huanyuan Shan, Qian Zheng, Quan Guo, Yan Huang, Kuanjun Li, Tianyang Liu
arxiv-2210-13483.description: Abstract The global neutral hydrogen 21 cm signal extracted from the all-sky averaged radio spectra is one of the signatures of the Cosmic Dawn and Epoch of Reionization (CD/EoR). The frequency-dependency of antenna beam patterns coupled with the strong foreground emission could introduce artificial spectral structures and cause false detection.

arxiv-2303-17136.title: Impact of iso-structural template layer on stabilizing pyrochlore Bi 2 Rh 2 O 7
arxiv-2303-17136.creator: M. Ohno, T. C. Fujita, M. Kawasaki
arxiv-2303-17136.description: Abstract We present an epitaxial stabilization of pyrochlore Bi 2 Rh 2 O 7 on Y-stabilized ZrO 2 (YSZ) (111) substrate by inserting a pyrochlore Eu 2 Ti 2 O 7 template layer, otherwise Bi-based layered structures being formed directly on YSZ (111) substrate. This result reveals that “iso-structural crystal phase” plays an important role in the interfacial phase control.

arxiv-2307-10397.title: Experimental generation and characterization of partially spatially coherent qubits
arxiv-2307-10397.creator: Preeti Sharma, Sakshi Rao, Bhaskar Kanseri
arxiv-2307-10397.description: Abstract Partially spatially coherent qubits are more immune to turbulent atmospheric conditions than coherent qubits, which makes them excellent candidates for free-space quantum communication. In this article, we report the generation of partially spatially coherent qubits in a spontaneous parametric down-conversion (SPDC) process using a Gaussian Schell model (GSM) pump beam.

arxiv-2411-03957.title: Fine-Grained Guidance for Retrievers: Leveraging LLMs’ Feedback in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
arxiv-2411-03957.creator: Yuhang Liu, Xueyu Hu, Shengyu Zhang, Jingyuan Chen, Fan Wu, Fei Wu
arxiv-2411-03957.description: Abstract Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has proven to be an effective method for mitigating hallucination issues inherent in large language models (LLMs). Previous approaches typically train retrievers based on semantic similarity, lacking optimization for RAG. More recent works have proposed aligning retrievers with the preference signals of LLMs.

arxiv-2501-00374.title: Deep learning for exploring hadron-hadron interactions
arxiv-2501-00374.creator: Lingxiao Wang
arxiv-2501-00374.description: Abstract In this proceeding, we introduce deep learning technologies for studying hadron-hadron interactions. To extract parameterized hadron interaction potentials from collision experiments, we employ a supervised learning approach using Femtoscopy data. The deep neural networks (DNNs) are trained to learn the inverse mapping from observations to potentials.

arxiv-2501-08745.title: Is magnitude ‘generically continuous’ for finite metric spaces?
arxiv-2501-08745.creator: Hirokazu Katsumasa, Emily Roff, Masahiko Yoshinaga
arxiv-2501-08745.description: Abstract . Magnitude is a real-valued invariant of metric spaces which, in the finite setting, can be understood as recording the ‘effective number of points’ in a space as the scale of the metric varies. Motivated by applications in topological data analysis, this paper investigates the stability of magnitude: its continuity properties with respect to the Gromov–Hausdorff topology.

arxiv-2501-13824.title: Hallucinations Can Improve Large Language Models in Drug Discovery
arxiv-2501-13824.creator: Shuzhou Yuan, Michael Färber
arxiv-2501-13824.description: Abstract Concerns about hallucinations in Large Language Models (LLMs) have been raised by researchers, yet their potential in areas where creativity is vital, such as drug discovery, merits exploration. In this paper, we come up with the hypothesis that hallucinations can improve LLMs in drug discovery.

arxiv-2503-18423.title: Thermally-controlled magnetooptical metasurface for tunable Faraday rotation
arxiv-2503-18423.creator: P. V. Golovko, D. O. Ignatyeva, S. Xia, P. E. Zimnyakova, L. Bi, V.I. Belotelov
arxiv-2503-18423.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by P. V. Golovko, D. O. Ignatyeva, S. Xia, P. E. Zimnyakova, L. Bi, V.I. Belotelov. We present novel type of tunable magneto-optical metasurfaces performing Faraday rotation, the sign and value of which are not fixed after the structure fabrication but can be tuned in a wide range via heating of the metasurface.

arxiv-2509-21191.title: Not All Accuracy Is Equal: Prioritizing Diversity in Infectious Disease Forecasting
arxiv-2509-21191.creator: Carson Dudley, Marisa Eisenberg
arxiv-2509-21191.description: Abstract Ensemble forecasts have become a cornerstone of large-scale disease response, underpinning decision making at agencies such as the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC). Their growing use reflects the goal of combining multiple models to improve accuracy and stability versus using a single model. However, recent experience shows these benefits are not guaranteed.

arxiv-2512-18454.title: Out-of-Distribution Detection in Molecular Complexes via Diffusion Models for Irregular Graphs
arxiv-2512-18454.description: Abstract Predictive machine learning models generally excel on in-distribution data, but their performance degrades on out-of-distribution (OOD) inputs. Reliable deployment therefore requires robust OOD detection, yet this is particularly challenging for irregular 3D graphs that combine continuous geometry with categorical identities and are unordered by construction.

europmc-pmc9289789.creator: GBD 2020 Alcohol Collaborators.
europmc-pmc9289789.description: Background The health risks associated with moderate alcohol consumption continue to be debated. Small amounts of alcohol might lower the risk of some health outcomes but increase the risk of others, suggesting that the overall risk depends, in part, on background disease rates,

pmc-10625302.title: Associations between depressive symptoms and 5-year subsequent work nonparticipation due to long-term sickness absence, unemployment and early retirement in a cohort of 2,413 employees in Germany
pmc-10625302.creator: Uwe Rose, Norbert Kersten, Dagmar Pattloch, Paul Maurice Conway, Hermann Burr
pmc-10625302.description: BackgroundWe examined the association of depressive symptoms with subsequent events – and duration thereof – of work nonparticipation (long-term sickness absence, unemployment and early retirement).MethodsWe employed a 5-year cohort from the Study on Mental Health at Work (S-MGA), based on a random sample of employees subject to social contributions aged 31–60 years in 2012 (N = 2413).

pmc-11352588.title: Clinical Characteristics and Outcomes of Dilated Cardiomyopathy in Chinese Children: A Single-Center Retrospective Study
pmc-11352588.creator: Cheng Chen, Yanyun Huang, Danyan Su, Suyuan Qin, Bingbing Ye, Yuqin Huang, Dongli Liu, Yusheng Pang
pmc-11352588.description: Background: The reported outcomes of pediatric dilated cardiomyopathy (DCM) have varied across studies. There are few outcome data concerning DCM in Chinese children. Therefore, we conducted a retrospective study to describe clinical features and determine risk factors for poor outcomes in children with DCM. Methods: We enrolled 121 children with DCM in our hospital from 2003 to 2021.

pmc-11407312.title: Mupirocin for Skin Infection: Clinical Experience from China
pmc-11407312.creator: Jing Sun, Tracy Lu, Yan Dang, Zigang Xu, Ying Liu
pmc-11407312.description: Mupirocin, an antibiotic produced by Pseudomonas fluorescens, is mainly used for the topical treatment of various skin and soft tissue infections caused by Staphylococcus (including methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus) and Streptococcus around the world for decades. Nevertheless, the clinical application scope of mupirocin varies in different countries due to differences in their medical policies, prescription types, and drug resistance.

pmc-11626746.title: Diabetes distress and associated factors among adults with diabetes mellitus residing in a metropolitan city of India: a community-based study
pmc-11626746.creator: Anam Anil Alwani, Ravneet Kaur, Mohan Bairwa, Puneet Misra, Baridalyne Nongkynrih
pmc-11626746.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundDiabetes distress “refers to the negative emotional or affective experiences resulting from the challenge of living with the demands of diabetes.” Despite recommendations to screen for distress at regular intervals, it usually remains undiagnosed.

pmc-12494683.title: The energy and stress evolution law of surrounding rock in gob side entry driving of adjacent mining faces
pmc-12494683.creator: Zi-Long Hui, Zhi-Qiang Zhao, Xiao-Xiang Wei, Yao-Li
pmc-12494683.description: Regarding the asymmetric large deformation occurring in the No. 13,313 return airway of the Sunjiagou Coal Mine due to multiple mining disturbances, research methods including numerical simulation and field measurements were employed, considering the engineering geological conditions, to analyze the main influencing factors of roadway instability and to obtain the energy-stress distribution characteristics of the surrounding rock.

pmc-12594778.title: Matrix cleanup assisted extraction of phenolic pollutants from diverse wastewaters using a magnetic core shell adsorbent
pmc-12594778.creator: Sina Mohammad Mehri, Mir Ali Farajzadeh, Mohammad Reza Afshar Mogaddam
pmc-12594778.description: This study introduces a novel and environmentally relevant sample preparation strategy for the trace-level determination of hazardous phenolic pollutants in complex wastewater matrices. Unlike conventional extraction methods that merely tolerate matrix interferences, this approach eliminates them before analyte extraction, improving selectivity and reliability.

pmc-12763961.title: Efficacy of levosimendan for acute decompensated heart failure with preserved ejection fraction in the elderly: a single-center retrospective analysis
pmc-12763961.creator: Xiaohong Xu, Fangchao Lv, Chenkai Xu, Xiuxiu Lai
pmc-12763961.description: AimsCurrent guidelines recommend medical treatment for heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF) but do not address inotropic drug use during acute HF episodes. This real-world study aimed to evaluate the effects of levosimendan in elderly patients presenting with acute HFpEF.MethodsWe retrospectively identified patients aged ≥ 65 years hospitalized with acute HFpEF at our institution.

pmc-13019340.title: GH001 vs Placebo in Patients With Treatment-Resistant Depression
pmc-13019340.creator: Wiesław J. Cubała, Malek Bajbouj, Michael Bauer, Bernhard T. Baune, Narcís Cardoner, Fabian Devlin, Kelly Doolin, Rosa Maria Dueñas Herrero, Matilde Elices, Avril Feeney, Maria Gałuszko-Węgielnik, Katarzyna Jakuszkowiak-Wojten, Luboš Janů, John R. Kelly, Kathryn Ledden, Rachael Maclsaac, Santiago Ma
pmc-13019340.description: Key PointsQuestionDoes single-day treatment with inhaled mebufotenin (GH001) using an individualized dosing regimen reduce symptoms of depression in patients with treatment-resistant depression?FindingsIn this randomized, double-blind phase 2b trial among 81 patients, GH001 treatment significantly reduced Montgomery-Åsberg Depression Rating Scale scores from baseline to day 8 vs placebo. Patients treated with GH001 experienced significantly greater remission than those receiving placebo.

pmc-13264179.title: Association of physiological parameters with final pH in beef
pmc-13264179.creator: Rudney da Silva Maia Júnior, Emanuela Costa Fernandes, Patrícia Fernandes Nunes da Silva Malavazi, Jilssyane Richelle da Silva Souza, Anderson Azevedo Mesquita, Patrícia Gelli Feres de Marchi, Cassio Toledo Messias, Bruna Laurindo Rosa
pmc-13264179.description: Highlights•Serum activity of the enzyme lactate dehydrogenase was correlated with final pH.•Age measured by dental chronology was correlated with final pH.•Glucose measured using a portable glucometer did not correlate with the pH and differed from that measured by the laboratory method.•Non-castrated males showed different correlations from castrated males.

pmc-13404416.title: Caregiver beliefs and practices about communication disorders in early childhood development centres from Durban: A qualitative study
pmc-13404416.creator: Vuyelwa Zandile Peter, Mershen Pillay, Yougan Saman

pmc-13474792.title: Human stem cell models in cerebral cavernous malformations
pmc-13474792.creator: Qi Wang, Jiajun Sun, Xuesai Zhu, Tengbo Yu, Xiao Xiao
pmc-13474792.description: Cerebral cavernous malformation (CCM) is a rare cerebrovascular disorder characterized by abnormal endothelial architecture and clinically manifests as hemorrhage, epilepsy, and neurological deficits. Two primary factors have constrained the advancement of research in the field of CCM. Firstly, the utilization of animal models, which do not fully recapitulate human neurovascular biology, has been a major impediment.

pmc-13505221.title: Maternal and neonatal outcomes in Gaza amid armed hostilities in 2025
pmc-13505221.creator: Shaymaa Abuhaiba, Younis Elijla, Aya El‐Dadah, Othman Nassar, Meran Abu‐Sultan, Maysaa Almasry, Hebatallah Alkhatib, Mahmoud Alsady, Amir Mahdi Ghafarian, Muath Alsarafandi, Lina Abumughessib, Arham Ali, Yassar Arain, Abeerah Muhammad, Belal Aldabbour, Shayan Ali, Bilal Irfan
pmc-13505221.description: ObjectiveThis study documents facility‐based maternal, obstetric, and neonatal outcomes and associated conflict‐related exposures and living conditions among pregnancy‐related encounters at Al‐Helou Maternity Hospital in Gaza from late April to early September 2025, with a small number of additional encounters recorded at Al‐Shifa Medical Complex.MethodsWe conducted an observational, facility‐based study using a combined retrospective‐prospective approach. All recorded obstetric encounters were eligible.

pmc-13548161.title: Improved stabilisation of human pancreas biopsies: Comparative evaluation of RNA preservation methods
pmc-13548161.creator: Rhys R Pook, Abbie Hearne, Rachel A Botting, Samuel J Tingle, Minna Honkanen-Scott, James A M Shaw, Simi Ali, William E Scott III
pmc-13548161.description: BACKGROUNDThe pancreas is particularly vulnerable to rapid post-retrieval degradation due to its high endogenous RNase and enzymatic activity. This presents a major challenge in both pancreas research and clinical transplantation for accurate transcriptomic analyses. Accurate molecular profiling is increasingly important for evaluating graft quality and characterising injury.

pmc-13625891.title: Gender diversity and cholesterol in early adolescence: Findings from the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development Study
pmc-13625891.creator: Jason M Nagata, Priyadharshini Balasubramanian, Audrey Lopez, Christiane K Helmer, Jennifer H Wong, Iris Yuefan Shao, Christopher D Otmar, Kyle T Ganson, Alexander Testa, Erin E Dooley, Holly C Gooding, Kelley Pettee Gabriel, Fiona C Baker
pmc-13625891.description: ObjectivesPrevious research has shown that gender minorities face health inequities, including mental and physical health disparities, but few studies have examined cardiovascular disparities, such as lipid profiles, in early adolescents. Monitoring cholesterol in adolescence is important, as early lipid levels can predict future cardiovascular risk.
